name: Trogg Stone Tooth
summary: In Loch Modan, Trogg Stone Tooth comes from the Stonesplinter troggs in the hills. Rugged and mineralized, each tooth gives dwarven defenders proof that the troggs are being hunted along the southern frontier.

sections.title: Bounty of the Southern Gate
sections.body: Captain Rugelfuss calls for volunteers to hunt the Stonesplinter troggs near Loch Modan's southern gate. With the Ironforge Reserve committed to the Alliance Front, local dwarven garrisons are stretched thin across Khaz Modan. Rugelfuss cannot spare the soldiers at the southern gate guard tower for patrols in the nearby hills. His standing call asks volunteers to hunt the lurking troggs and bring back Trogg Stone Teeth as crude, undeniable proof of each beast slain.

faq.q: Who wants these trogg stone teeth?
faq.answer: Captain Rugelfuss at Loch Modan's southern guard tower collects the teeth as proof that travelers are hunting Stonesplinter troggs.

faq.q: Why are the teeth made of stone?
faq.answer: Troggs have an earthy, subterranean nature tied to ancient stone origins. Their tusks and teeth are heavy and mineralized, like raw rock.

faq.q: Why can't the dwarven garrison hunt the troggs themselves?
aliases: why are dwarves not fighting troggs
faq.answer: The Ironforge Reserve has joined the broader Alliance war effort, leaving local outposts undermanned. Captain Rugelfuss's regiment must guard the southern gate and cannot risk leaving its fortification unmanned.

aliases: where to get trogg stone teeth
faq.answer: The teeth come from Stonesplinter troggs in Loch Modan's hills and excavations, including common diggers, scouts, bone-snapping warriors, and geomancers.

angles.text: As a dwarf, each recovered tooth helps secure Khaz Modan while much of Ironforge's military serves abroad with the Alliance.
As an Alliance member, answering Captain Rugelfuss's call eases pressure on the trade paths linking the dwarven kingdoms to the wider Alliance.
